# OpenCode ACP 1.19.6 evidence

[Research 489](../../../../../docs/research/489-opencode-acp-1-19-6-identity.md)
records the two ACP qualification gates. The source hashes are ordered
by `compared` and cover the ACP wire and MCP sources, plus the provider,
session, and dependency files used to trace the gates. The referenced
[Research 486 ledgers](../opencode-http-1.19.6/) retain the complete
native identity and tag-tree inventories for both hops.
